entities.name: ATP synthase subunit b
observations: 161 aa protein with an N-terminal hydrophobic membrane anchor and a long, highly charged alpha-helical C-terminal region.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt B0ULY4 from Methylobacterium sp. strain 4-46.
Pfam matches: ATP-synt_B (PF00430), positions 6–135; Mt_ATP-synt_B (PF05405), positions 3–154.
Curated function: peripheral-stalk component of the membrane F1F0 ATP synthase, linking F1 to F0.
Curated localization: bacterial inner membrane; single-pass membrane protein.
Curated complex context: ATP synthase peripheral stalk contains subunit b together with delta; subunit b commonly forms a b2 homodimer.

entities.name: F1F0 ATP synthase
observations: Rotary proton- or sodium-coupled ATP-producing complex with membrane F0 and catalytic F1 sectors.
Subunit b is part of the peripheral stalk that mechanically supports and links F1 to F0.

entities.name: ATP synthase subunit b sequence features
observations: Length 161 aa; predicted molecular weight 17,793.934 Da; theoretical pI 7.917.
Sequence architecture is consistent with one N-terminal transmembrane helix followed by a soluble, charged, helix-rich stalk domain.
